scope: Real production WebView2 surface, mapped software CPU, worker, IndexedDB, Web Locks and backup restore; no ARM ISA or host OS simulation claim

checks.name: Production runtime seal and mapped software CPU closure
Secure mapped origin boots the real module worker and MessageChannel terminal
Production bridge refuses cross-origin navigation without replacing the CPU surface
Software byte lanes, real IndexedDB commit and production backup export
Reload restores exact committed file content and CPU field previews
Second production WebView2 surface cannot acquire the active writer lock
Malformed backup restore preserves the running virtual volume
Validated production restore restarts the real worker and recovers exact file and CPU state
